artists.biography: The Magpie Salute is an exciting new band that features musicians who have played together for decades throughout various projects and share a musical bond. The band brings Rich Robinson, the guitarist and co-founding member of The Black Crowes, together with two key members of Crowes fame - guitarist Marc Ford and bassist Sven Pipien - alongside drummer Joe Magistro and guitarist Nico Bereciartua. The Magpie Salute also boasts a fine cast of vocalists, including lead singer John Hogg (Hookah Brown, Moke), former Crowes singer Charity White and background singers, Adrien Reju and Katrine Ottosen.

perplexity.description:
High Water I is the debut studio album by American rock band The Magpie Salute, released on August 10, 2018, through Eagle Records (also associated with Mascot/Eagle Rock) . The album was produced by the band's leader and guitarist Rich Robinson and recorded at Dark Horse Studios in Nashville. It follows their 2017 self-titled live album and precedes High Water II (2019) . The lineup includes former Black Crowes members Marc Ford and Sven Pipien, alongside John Hogg, Joe Magistro, and Matt Slocum .

Musically, High Water I blends rock with strong influences of blues-rock, Southern rock, and American traditional rock, showcasing a classic yet fresh sound that reflects the members' roots and experience . The album features a mix of original compositions primarily by Rich Robinson and John Hogg, with contributions from Marc Ford. Its style is characterized by melodic guitar work, soulful vocals, and a warm, organic production that highlights the band's cohesive musicianship .

Commercially, High Water I reached number 33 on the US Billboard 200 chart, marking a solid debut for the band in the rock genre . Critically, it was well received for its authentic rock sound and the successful transition from live performances to a polished studio effort, establishing The Magpie Salute as a notable act in contemporary rock circles .
